dedupe_keys.name: cellularxsim paired measured and simulated radio network paths

description: CellularXsim pairs observed mobile radio indicators with propagation-simulation outputs for studies of transfer from simulation to field measurements. The CellularX maintainers provide four designed routes with real observations and six corresponding simulator configurations, plus randomly roamed observations for testing. CSV variables include received signal strength and quality, interference ratios and positions; the repository also publishes base-station information and a Wireless InSite project. Coverage is one study area, with exact boundaries and acquisition dates not established in the inspected documentation. The data card reports approximately 18,000 instances and a June 2023 version. Public data access is free for non-commercial reuse under CC BY-NC 4.0; running the external simulator has separate requirements. A limitation is contradictory latitude/longitude descriptions in the data dictionary, requiring coordinate checks before spatial use. Simulation uses include comparing propagation scenarios and evaluating the gap between simulated and measured radio behaviour. No related catalogue resource was identified as this paired dataset. The broader CellularXreal collection of 982 users is described but still marked for future upload, so it is excluded from this draft. Files were listed without downloading data or the simulator project.
